capabilities.label: Customer funding & relationships
capabilities.value_stream_context: Need → account opening → savings/payments → retention
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Stable funding and customer service can support spread economics; deposit stock is not revenue.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Customer/channel teams; published Group CFO/COO are relevant inquiry roles, not attested capability owners.
capabilities.process: Onboard, service, price, monitor funding behaviour
capabilities.information: Balances, product rates, account activity; no customer records retrieved
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No current account platform supplier/system is established here.

capabilities.label: Credit allocation & servicing
capabilities.value_stream_context: Assess need → underwrite → lend → service/recover
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Interest income must be evaluated with funding, impairment, operating costs and capital.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Lending, risk and servicing roles are analytical placements.
capabilities.process: Credit assessment, affordability, collateral and arrears handling
capabilities.information: Exposure, repayment and risk information categories; no internal decision model acquired
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No current underwriting stack or external delivery gap verified.

capabilities.label: AI platform enablement & control
capabilities.value_stream_context: Multiple customer/colleague journeys; enabling capability, not a sales activity
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Incremental net benefit depends on adoption, quality, control and ongoing platform cost.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Published Group COO/CRO/CFO roles provide possible accountability context; Envoy RACI unverified.
capabilities.process: Select use case → apply controls → deploy/monitor → evaluate incremental outcomes
capabilities.information: Model/use-case inventory, permissions, telemetry and benefit evidence are information needs
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Envoy / Google Cloud brand collaboration and described controls are reported; exact legal hosting, workload and service architecture unresolved.

capabilities.label: Enterprise economics & capital allocation
capabilities.value_stream_context: Measure → challenge → allocate → monitor returns
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Profit, liquidity, capital and distributable cash are related but distinct resources.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Group CFO role published; individual investment committee decisions not acquired.
capabilities.process: Reconcile management/statutory views and capital constraints
capabilities.information: Income, lease effects, remediation, impairment, capital and economic assumptions
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No budgeting application or supplier allocation inferred from total profit.

capabilities.label: Customer outcome assurance
capabilities.value_stream_context: Use service → raise issue → resolve → learn
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Quality, remediation and customer retention may interact; no causal complaint-cost conversion.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Published Consumer, Business & Commercial and risk roles; no private caseworker data.
capabilities.process: Operational/service and risk review as conceptual processes
capabilities.information: Service outcomes must be scope/period matched; complaints are not matched cohorts
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No asserted failure of current controls, service platform or outsourcer.

capabilities.label: Wealth, insurance & pensions propositions
capabilities.value_stream_context: Plan → contribute/protect → invest → claim/retire
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Different fee/insurance and asset-management mechanisms should not be forced into bank NIM.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Published Wealth & Insurance / Scottish Widows role; not a legal-entity consolidation map.
capabilities.process: Advice/service, contribution and claims lifecycles are conceptual
capabilities.information: Policy, contribution, assets and customer outcome information categories
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No custody, fund-platform or insurer supplier contract inferred.

capabilities.label: Mortgage lending & lifecycle service
capabilities.value_stream_context: Housing need → affordability/valuation → offer/completion → repayment/support
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Mortgage yield must fund saver returns, losses, service cost and capital; member value can affect pricing choices.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Mortgage, risk, distribution and treasury are conceptual responsibility groupings; CEO is published, operational owners not verified.
capabilities.process: Origination, underwriting, completion, account servicing and support
capabilities.information: Affordability, property, loan and arrears data categories; no private records or decision policy inspected
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No named mortgage platform, cloud or AI exposure established.

capabilities.label: Savings, membership & funding
capabilities.value_stream_context: Save → access funds → use benefits → renew relationship
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Saver value and retained financial strength constrain pure margin maximisation.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Treasury/product/service roles conceptual; no named buyer authority.
capabilities.process: Membership eligibility, account service and product economics
capabilities.information: Balances, pricing, eligibility and capital/liquidity information categories
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No deposit platform supplier established by Group results.

capabilities.label: Business integration & customer continuity
capabilities.value_stream_context: Legal transfer → maintain service → change platforms/products with controls
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Integration expense is not proof of failure or an open work package; delivered benefits and residual decisions need separate proof.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: CEO context published; programme sponsor/RACI remains an evidence gap.
capabilities.process: Plan legal/operational change, reconcile accounts, notify customers, test continuity
capabilities.information: Legal account perimeter, brands, service channels and milestones
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Legal transfer occurred; issuer says Virgin Money interfaces initially continue. Architecture consolidation is not thereby verified.

capabilities.label: Member value & financial stewardship
capabilities.value_stream_context: Earn → retain strength → allocate eligible member benefits
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Underlying/statutory reconciliation includes rewards and acquisition adjustments; rewards are not a technology budget.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: CEO/finance/membership governance roles should be confirmed against current responsibilities.
capabilities.process: Balance pricing, rewards, risk and retained capital
capabilities.information: Eight retained financial facts plus separately sourced membership conditions
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No inference of every customer being a member or every member receiving payment.

capabilities.label: Account/payment service coordination
capabilities.value_stream_context: Initiate → validate → transmit → reconcile/service
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Society customer outcome depends on shared payment services as well as its own operations.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Payments/service and risk roles are conceptual; no bank-specific vendor map.
capabilities.process: Coordinate account access, external rails and customer support
capabilities.information: Payment status, account and exception categories; no transaction/customer data retained
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Pay.UK guarantor membership is verified as a published governance fact, not a technology contract.

capabilities.label: Prudential & operational risk management
capabilities.value_stream_context: Assess → control → monitor → adapt
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Loss absorption, liquidity and service continuity limit distributable surplus and change capacity.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Risk/finance/operations role hypotheses, not actual approval authority.
capabilities.process: Assess asset quality, funding and service change within existing controls
capabilities.information: Credit, operational and capital information; no control-effectiveness evidence acquired
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No integration incident or missing control claimed from expenditure or legal transfer.

capabilities.label: Cloud platform operations
capabilities.value_stream_context: Customer workload → provision resources → run/monitor → bill/support
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Capacity utilisation, service mix and delivery costs interact with consumption; TPU system sales add a hardware/inventory mechanism.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Product, SRE, infrastructure and finance role categories are conceptual; Thomas Kurian title is published.
capabilities.process: Capacity planning, provisioning, secure operation, support and retirement
capabilities.information: Usage/availability/capacity/incident and billing categories; no customer telemetry retrieved
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Issuer infrastructure reference layers, not Lloyds deployment or current exact region topology.

capabilities.label: Contract, consumption & customer value
capabilities.value_stream_context: Choose service/terms → commit/provision → consume → charge/renew
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Reported global segment results do not disclose UK/EMEA customer prices or legal-entity margin.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Cloud commercial and finance roles; no named account executive or buying sponsor inferred.
capabilities.process: Select applicable entity/services, meter use, invoice and support
capabilities.information: Agreement scope, billing location and service usage are information needs
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Standard terms cannot substitute for actual executed Lloyds or reseller agreement.

capabilities.label: Infrastructure capacity & lifecycle economics
capabilities.value_stream_context: Plan capacity → procure/build → deploy → operate → refresh
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Cash for facilities/servers/inventory precedes some revenue and expense recognition; no Cloud-only capex allocation inferred.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Infrastructure, engineering and finance responsibility hypotheses.
capabilities.process: Plan deployment, lifecycle and energy/maintenance needs
capabilities.information: Asset life, energy/capacity, demand and supplier evidence categories
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: June2024 reference describes owned and third-party premises; no specific data-centre provider contract asserted.

capabilities.label: Provider assurance & regulated service continuity
capabilities.value_stream_context: Identify service scope → demonstrate controls → test continuity → review changes
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Designation creates provider oversight context; a particular bank’s loss, deficient control or unmet need is not established.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Company service/risk roles and bank third-party-risk roles remain separate.
capabilities.process: Evidence service boundaries, incidents, subcontracting and continuity
capabilities.information: Legal provider, covered service, criticality and control evidence; no canonical pressure qualified
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Google Cloud EMEA is named CTP; Google brand/segment/affiliates remain distinct.

capabilities.label: Managed data & AI services
capabilities.value_stream_context: Ingest/prepare → govern → train/infer/query → observe
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Service adoption may expand compute/storage consumption, but no customer benefit, savings or budget inferred.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Product, security, data and customer roles are conceptual.
capabilities.process: Manage customer-configurable service and data boundaries
capabilities.information: Data categories/model/service identities are information needs, not a workload inventory
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Global service descriptions and subprocessor scopes are not evidence that Envoy uses any particular service.

capabilities.label: Affiliate & third-party service coordination
capabilities.value_stream_context: Define service → assign bounded processing/support roles → govern/change
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Third-party delivery supports service capability and creates assurance dependencies; company spend/workshare undisclosed.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Disclosed affiliate/subprocessor functions; no assumed universal staff access.
capabilities.process: Maintain scoped disclosures and customer service arrangements
capabilities.information: Processor/service/region/activity and permission distinctions
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Google Cloud EMEA Limited and Google Ireland Ltd. are separate listed entities.

capabilities.label: Payment-system operation & service continuity
capabilities.value_stream_context: PSP instruction → validate/clear → settle through arrangements → reconcile
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Service funding and network continuity are different economics from lending spreads; transaction value is not operator revenue.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Published COO David Morris relevant to operational inquiry; not attested every-system owner.
capabilities.process: Operate rules/service, monitor exceptions, manage continuity
capabilities.information: Instruction/status/routing and operational evidence categories; no participant/customer data retrieved
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Pay.UK operator, FPS/Bacs/ICS systems, central-bank settlement and participant ledgers are distinct.

capabilities.label: Participant access & assurance
capabilities.value_stream_context: Request access → satisfy criteria/agreements → connect/test → operate
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Access choices allocate cost, risk and service responsibilities; no published fee applied to a named bank.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Operations, legal and risk responsibilities are analytical placements.
capabilities.process: Admission and ongoing access lifecycle; no gated documents accessed
capabilities.information: Participant identity, permissions, connectivity and assurance evidence categories
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: ICS public agreement framework is not a signed named-party contract.

capabilities.label: Fraud reimbursement coordination
capabilities.value_stream_context: Register → exchange claim information → decide/reimburse → monitor
capabilities.economic_mechanism: RCMS common-service cost recovery differs from PSP reimbursement liability and fraud loss.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Operator COO/risk context published; individual PSP retains its own responsibilities.
capabilities.process: Coordinate service and participant information flow; do not infer adjudication authority
capabilities.information: Claims/status/behaviour information categories; no actual cases or personal information retrieved
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: RCMS FAQ anticipates billing changes; no exact tariff or customer bill asserted.

capabilities.label: Scheme rules & information standards
capabilities.value_stream_context: Identify need → consult/define → assure implementation → maintain
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Common standards can reduce coordination friction; savings and adoption remain unmeasured.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Strategy/Transformation and governance role context published.
capabilities.process: Develop rules and standards with distinct participants/regulators
capabilities.information: Definitions, versions, change and conformance evidence categories
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: No new ISO20022 programme delivery date or supplier workshare invented.

capabilities.label: Stakeholder governance & funding allocation
capabilities.value_stream_context: Engage service users → challenge priorities → allocate/review → account
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Guarantor accountability and participant interests differ from shareholder return maximisation.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Board/guarantor roles explicit; CFO Michael Ellis is a published role, not every commercial decision maker.
capabilities.process: Board/member and stakeholder challenge alongside financial stewardship
capabilities.information: Member roles, funding evidence, options and decision records
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Lloyds Bank plc / Nationwide are named guarantors; not voting dominance or service exposure.

capabilities.label: Infrastructure/service change management
capabilities.value_stream_context: Maintain continuity → design change → test/adopt → measure outcomes
capabilities.economic_mechanism: Current reliable services and future changes compete for resources; no open procurement or available budget established.
capabilities.people_and_accountability: Published David Crawford Strategy/Transformation; actual programme mandates require evidence.
capabilities.process: Coordinate operator, participants, infrastructure supplier and regulator change
capabilities.information: Roadmap, contract perimeter, migration and readiness evidence categories
capabilities.technology_and_dependencies: Retained supplier leads require scope/date/use verification; old NPA labels are not current procurement authority.

capability_vs_value_stream: Durable ability versus a sequence of value-delivery activities; supporting a journey does not prove causal outcomes or a legal organisational boundary.

frameworks.BIZBOK: inspired organising method, no adoption of licensed model or canonical standard
